recipe.visualDefinition: A group of six men in casual country attire posed against a weathered red brick wall in a rustic indoor setting with dark wood flooring. The composition features a large, stylized header and a clean subtitle at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group arranged horizontally across the mid-ground
High-contrast red header against textured brick
Warm, directional lighting casting soft shadows on the wall
Casual, relaxed posing creating a sense of camaraderie
coreInvariants: Dark hardwood floor with visible grain
Arched display typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six subjects positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to appear full-body or three-quarter length.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the black shirt and white cowboy hat acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large red header, moves down through the central figures, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dedicated to the brick wall and primary title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earthy tones (terracotta brick, brown wood, tan jackets).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red in the header and blue denim in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white in shirts and hats to provide highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red title; muted, natural saturation in the photographic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with western spurs
letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the main title
Thick black outlines with white inner borders
Decorative spurs on the midpoints of vertical strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged first and last characters to frame the arch
Concave curves on the top and bottom of horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact decorative western display paired with a clean, legible classical serif.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows to separate text from textured background

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, traditional serif look for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of six men in country attire (denim, cowboy hats, leather jackets) posed in a line against a weathered red brick wall. The floor is dark polished wood. Lighting is warm and directional from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched title in a red western slab-serif font with a double outline at the top. Add a smaller white serif subtitle centered at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the brick wall have realistic texture and mortar lines?
Are the subjects wearing appropriate country/western clothing?
Is the lighting consistent across the group?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the arch in the title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not touching the heads of the subjects
Check that the floor and wall meet at a realistic perspective line
Verify the red of the title is the most saturated element
Confirm all subjects are in focus
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Brick Wall + Country Band Posing + Arched Western Display Type + Warm Interior Lighting
